slot.brief: Indefinite integral requiring integration by parts, possibly applied twice or with the 'ILATE' trick of adding the same integral to both sides.

stem: The value of $\displaystyle\int x^2\cos x\,dx$ is

verdicts.working: By parts, ∫x² cos x dx = x² sin x + 2x cos x − 2 sin x + C.

working:
$\int x^2\cos x\,dx=x^2\sin x-2\int x\sin x\,dx$. Also, $\int x\sin x\,dx=-x\cos x+\sin x$. Thus the integral is $x^2\sin x+2x\cos x-2\sin x+C$.

Independent check: By parts, ∫x² cos x dx = x² sin x + 2x cos x − 2 sin x + C.
solution:
By integration by parts, $\int x^2\cos x\,dx=x^2\sin x-2\int x\sin x\,dx$, and $\int x\sin x\,dx=-x\cos x+\sin x$.
$$\int x^2\cos x\,dx=x^2\sin x+2x\cos x-2\u0000sin x+C$$
